??? example "Tasks in routes/console.php"

    ```php title="routes/console.php"
    use App\Jobs\ProcessOrder;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schedule;

    Schedule::command('reports:send')->dailyAt('3:15'); // → scheduled_tasks.kind command → scheduled_tasks.cron 15 3 * * *
    Schedule::job(new ProcessOrder)->everyFiveMinutes(); // → scheduled_tasks.target App\Jobs\ProcessOrder → scheduled_tasks.cron */5 * * * *
    Schedule::call(fn () => null)->hourly(); // → scheduled_tasks.kind closure → scheduled_tasks.target null
    Schedule::exec('node prune.js')->cron('0 4 * * 1'); // → scheduled_tasks.kind exec → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 4 * * 1
    Schedule::command('invoices:send')->daysOfMonth(1, 15); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 0 1,15 * *
    Schedule::command('taxes:file')->quarterlyOn(10, '8:00'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 8 10 1-12/3 *
    Schedule::command('queue:work')->everyTenSeconds(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron null → scheduled_tasks.frequency {"every":10,"unit":"seconds"}

    Artisan::command('carts:prune {--days=}', fn () => null)->daily(); // → scheduled_tasks.target carts:prune
    ```

??? example "Groups, conditions and constraints"

    ```php title="routes/console.php"
    use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schedule;

    Schedule::daily()->onOneServer()->group(function () {
        Schedule::command('reports:send'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 0 * * * → scheduled_tasks.on_one_server true
        Schedule::command('reports:archive')->hourly(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 * * * *
    });

    if (app()->isProduction()) {
        Schedule::command('backup:run')->daily()->weekdays()->between('1:00', '5:00')->withoutOverlapping(); // → scheduled_tasks.constraints if(\app()->isProduction()) → scheduled_tasks.constraints weekdays → scheduled_tasks.without_overlapping true
    }

    Schedule::command('cache:warm')->hourly()->environments('production')->when(fn () => true); // → scheduled_tasks.constraints when(closure)
    Schedule::command('queue:prune')->hourly()->timezone('Europe/Paris')->runInBackground(); // → scheduled_tasks.timezone Europe/Paris → scheduled_tasks.run_in_background true
    ```

??? example "Schedule handed to another class"

    ```php title="app/Console/Kernel.php"
    namespace App\Console;

    use App\Scheduling\BillingTasks;
    use App\Scheduling\CleanupTasks;
    use App\Scheduling\ReportTasks;
    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Console\Kernel as ConsoleKernel;

    class Kernel extends ConsoleKernel
    {
        protected ReportTasks $reports;

        protected function schedule(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            (new BillingTasks)->register($schedule);
            BillingTasks::nightly($schedule);

            (new CleanupTasks)->register($schedule);

            if (app()->isProduction()) {
                app(CleanupTasks::class)->register($schedule);
            }

            if (config('cleanup.staging')) {
                resolve(CleanupTasks::class)->register($schedule);
            }

            $this->reports->register($schedule); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Scheduling/BillingTasks.php"
    namespace App\Scheduling;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;

    class BillingTasks
    {
        public function register(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('invoices:charge')->daily(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 0 * * *
            $this->reminders($schedule);
        }

        public static function nightly(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('invoices:close')->dailyAt('23:00'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 23 * * *
        }

        private function reminders(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('invoices:remind')->hourly(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 * * * *
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Scheduling/CleanupTasks.php"
    namespace App\Scheduling;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;

    class CleanupTasks
    {
        public function register(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('logs:prune')->weekly(); // → scheduled_tasks.constraints [] → scheduled_tasks.constraints ["if(app()->isProduction())"] → scheduled_tasks.constraints ["if(config('cleanup.staging'))"]
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Scheduling/ReportTasks.php"
    namespace App\Scheduling;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;

    class ReportTasks
    {
        public function register(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('reports:send')->daily(); // ✗ not recorded
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="app/Scheduling/QueueTasks.php"
    namespace App\Scheduling;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;

    class QueueTasks
    {
        public function __invoke(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->job(new \App\Jobs\ProcessOrder)->everyFiveMinutes(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron */5 * * * *
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="bootstrap/app.php"
    use App\Scheduling\QueueTasks;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;

    return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
        ->withSchedule(new QueueTasks)
        ->create();
    ```

??? example "Console kernel and withSchedule"

    ```php title="app/Console/Kernel.php"
    namespace App\Console;

    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Console\Kernel as ConsoleKernel;

    class Kernel extends ConsoleKernel
    {
        protected function schedule(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('reports:send')->weekly()->at('9:30'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 30 9 * * 0
            $this->billing($schedule);
        }

        private function billing(Schedule $schedule): void
        {
            $schedule->command('invoices:charge')->monthlyOn(1, '6:00'); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 6 1 * *
        }
    }
    ```

    ```php title="bootstrap/app.php"
    use Illuminate\Console\Scheduling\Schedule;
    use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;

    return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
        ->withSchedule(function (Schedule $schedule) {
            $schedule->command('carts:prune')->daily(); // → scheduled_tasks.cron 0 0 * * *
        })
        ->create();
    ```
